title: Caldova Managed Portfolios — Investment menu & model summary (illustrative)
version: Menu as at 31 October 2026 — illustrative performance
summary: The six Caldova Managed Portfolios available in Caldova Super, Caldova Pension and Caldova Wrap (all tiers). Each is a diversified model portfolio run by Caldova's Investment Solutions team through the Caldova managed account service; the underlying investments are held in the member's own account. For each model: growth/defensive split, strategic asset allocation, indicative investment fee (ICR), buy/sell spread, standard risk measure (SRM) risk band, suggested minimum timeframe, objective and 1-, 3- and 5-year returns. ALL PERFORMANCE FIGURES ARE ILLUSTRATIVE for this demo — returns to 31 Oct 2026, after investment fees and costs, before administration fees and tax. Past performance is not a reliable indicator of future performance.
rules:
Conservative — 30% growth / 70% defensive (Australian shares 12%, international shares 13%, property & infrastructure 5%, fixed interest 50%, cash 20%). ICR 0.32%; buy/sell spread 0.10%. Risk band 3 — low to medium (1 to fewer than 2 negative annual returns expected in 20 years). Minimum timeframe 3 years. Objective CPI + 1.0% p.a. Returns: 1 yr 6.1%; 3 yrs 5.4% p.a.; 5 yrs 3.9% p.a.
Balanced — 60/40 (Australian shares 24%, international shares 28%, property & infrastructure 8%, fixed interest 30%, cash 10%). ICR 0.38%; spread 0.10%. Risk band 5 — medium to high (3 to fewer than 4). Minimum timeframe 5 years. Objective CPI + 2.5% p.a. Returns: 8.9%; 8.1% p.a.; 6.4% p.a.
Growth — 80/20 (Australian shares 32%, international shares 37%, property & infrastructure 11%, fixed interest 14%, cash 6%). ICR 0.42%; spread 0.10%. Risk band 6 — high (4 to fewer than 6). Minimum timeframe 7 years. Objective CPI + 3.5% p.a. Returns: 10.8%; 9.9% p.a.; 7.9% p.a.
High Growth — 95/5 (Australian shares 38%, international shares 44%, property & infrastructure 13%, cash 5%). ICR 0.45%; spread 0.10%. Risk band 6 — high (4 to fewer than 6). Minimum timeframe 8 years. Objective CPI + 4.0% p.a. Returns: 12.3%; 11.2% p.a.; 8.9% p.a.
Index Balanced — 60/40, passive index funds and ETFs, lowest fee (Australian shares 25%, international shares 30%, listed property 5%, fixed interest 32%, cash 8%). ICR 0.18%; spread 0.10%. Risk band 5 — medium to high. Minimum timeframe 5 years. Objective CPI + 2.5% p.a. Returns: 9.2%; 8.4% p.a.; 6.6% p.a.
Sustainable Growth — 80/20 with ESG screens: excludes thermal coal, tobacco and controversial weapons and targets lower carbon intensity than its benchmark (Australian shares 31%, international shares 39%, property & infrastructure 10%, fixed interest 15%, cash 5%). ICR 0.49%; spread 0.10%. Risk band 6 — high. Minimum timeframe 7 years. Objective CPI + 3.5% p.a. Returns: 10.1%; 9.2% p.a.; 7.4% p.a.
Risk-profile fit (target market): Conservative — low to medium risk tolerance; Balanced and Index Balanced — 'Balanced' profile, also commonly used for pension income portfolios alongside a cash reserve; Growth and Sustainable Growth — 'Growth' profile, 7+ years; High Growth — 'High Growth' profile, comfortable with large short-term falls.
Rebalancing: quarterly, or sooner if an asset class drifts more than 5% from target. Model changes are approved by Caldova's Investment Committee.
limits: Performance figures are illustrative, not actual returns. Asset allocations are strategic targets; actual holdings move within ranges. Members cannot change the holdings inside a model. A model's fit must be checked against the member's risk profile, Statement of Advice (advised members) and the target market determination. Caldova does not give personal advice — model selection for advised members is the adviser's recommendation.
evidenceRequired: Member's risk profile and Statement of Advice (advised members) to confirm model fit
Target market determination (TMD) check for the model and the product
Investment instruction naming the model(s) and percentage allocations (total 100%, with 1% minimum cash)
